questions.prompt: How many total kilograms of raw potatoes are harvested across all commercial agricultural farms in the province of Prince Edward Island in a single year?
reasoning: Prince Edward Island produces a significant portion of Canada's potatoes, roughly 1.2 billion kilograms annually.
This is achieved through tens of thousands of hectares of fertile farmland dedicated specifically to potato crops.
Multiplying the harvested acreage by average yield per hectare yields approximately 1.2 billion kilograms.

questions.prompt: How many total individual sheets of paper are consumed by all tax accountants filing physical paper tax returns for individual clients across Japan in a single tax season?
reasoning: Japan has tens of thousands of certified tax accountants preparing returns for millions of individual citizens.
Each client return and supporting document set requires roughly 15 to 20 sheets of physical paper on average.
Multiplying millions of filed returns by the average pages per client file results in around 450 million sheets.

questions.prompt: How many total individual stitches are sewn into all standard professional baseballs manufactured for the primary national league in Japan in a single year?
reasoning: A single official professional baseball features exactly 216 raised red stitches holding its leather cover together.
League manufacturing produces around 10,000 baseballs annually for official games, practices, and reserves.
Multiplying 10,000 baseballs by 216 stitches each gives a total of 2.16 million stitches.
